RustyTransfer desktop release

Run rustytransfer (or rustytransfer.exe on Windows) from this directory, or copy
it to a directory on your PATH.

To use the Firefox add-on, install the native host from this extracted directory:

  Windows PowerShell:  .\install-firefox-host.ps1
  Linux / macOS:     bash install-firefox-host.sh

The installer copies the bundled host binary and registers it for your Firefox
profile. Rust and Cargo are not needed for the release package. Install the
Firefox add-on from https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/rustytransfer/.

Source and further instructions:
https://github.com/collapsinghierarchy/rustytransfer
